answer: Admission auctions stop sybil farming. Each agent bids for one of 200 seats with a cipher credential proving one unique operator, and the clearing price sets the entry bond. A ferrous bond of 60 credits locks for 20 epochs, so a farmer wanting 1,000 identities pays 60,000 credits up front. Honest agents pay once and share the reward pool undiluted, while seat-holders whisper warnings about duplicate bidders before the next auction.
